AdventurerProfile.title: AdventurerProfile
AdventurerProfile.description: Stores the user's RPG persona, XP, level, and lifetime exploration stats.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the adventurer.

characterStyle.description: Selected RPG narrator and character archetype.

xp.description: Total experience points earned from quests and landmarks.

questsCompleted.description: Total number of walking quests completed.

landmarksVisited.description: Total number of real-world landmarks discovered.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CompletedQuest.title: CompletedQuest
CompletedQuest.description: Represents an active or completed real-world walking quest with landmarks and lore.

title.description: RPG quest title generated for the walk.

characterStyle.description: Character style under which the quest was undertaken.

summary.description: Narrative chronicle summary of the walking quest.

landmarksCount.description: Total number of real-world waypoints in this quest.

completedStops.description: Number of waypoints visited and cleared.

xpEarned.description: Total XP awarded for this quest.

stopsSummary.description: Bounded list of real-world landmark names included in the quest.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the quest was started via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the quest was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

EarnedBadge.title: EarnedBadge
EarnedBadge.description: An achievement badge unlocked by exploring real-world parks, plaques, and cafes.

landmarkName.description: Real-world landmark where the badge was earned.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the badge was unlocked via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: An RPG relic, cyber-deck module, chronicle page, or elixir found at a real-world landmark.

loreDescription.description: Lore description tying the item to the real-world landmark.

originLandmark.description: Real-world landmark where this item was discovered.

characterStyle.description: Persona archetype associated with the item.

powerBonus.description: Stat bonus granted by the item.

equipped.description: Whether the adventurer currently has this item equipped.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was acquired via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FoundArtifact.title: FoundArtifact
FoundArtifact.description: A cataloged real-world historical artifact, plaque rubbing, botanical specimen, or vision-verified curio discovered during a walking quest.

artifactCode.description: Unique catalog code for the found artifact.

name.description: Display title of the found artifact.

loreInscription.description: Historical and RPG lore inscription recorded when the artifact was discovered.

category.description: Curio classification of the found artifact.

landmarkName.description: Real-world landmark where the artifact was discovered.

regionName.description: City or district where the artifact was discovered.

resonanceValue.description: Arcane/historical resonance score of the artifact.

isFavorite.description: Whether the user has pinned this artifact to their Vault Showcase.

inspectionNotes.description: Personal field notes added by the explorer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the artifact was cataloged via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the artifact was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document storing RPG persona, level, XP, and exploration counters.

/users/{userId}/quests/{questId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing active and completed walking quests.

/users/{userId}/badges/{badgeId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing unlocked exploration badges.

/users/{userId}/inventory/{itemId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing RPG inventory items collected at landmarks.

/users/{userId}/artifacts/{artifactId}.description: User-scoped subcollection storing cataloged found artifacts, plaque rubbings, and vision curios.
